## Definition of done

- [ ] `pnpm verify` passes locally (format, lint, types, architecture, coverage, build)
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` passes, including the axe accessibility checks
- [ ] UI states covered where relevant: loading, empty, error
- [ ] Works with keyboard only and at 390 px width
- [ ] Spanish and English texts updated together
- [ ] Docs updated; new ADR if an architectural decision was made
- [ ] No internal hostnames, IPs, real operational data or personal data in content
